campaign_occurrence_overrides_shape_chec.name: campaign_occurrence_overrides_shape_check
campaign_occurrence_overrides_shape_chec.value:
(
        ("campaign_occurrence_overrides"."kind" = 'rescheduled' and "campaign_occurrence_overrides"."starts_at" is not null)
        or
        ("campaign_occurrence_overrides"."kind" <> 'rescheduled' and "campaign_occurrence_overrides"."starts_at" is null)
      )

campaigns_schedule_complete_check.name: campaigns_schedule_complete_check
campaigns_schedule_complete_check.value:
(
        ("campaigns"."recurrence" is null and "campaigns"."recurrence_start_at" is null and "campaigns"."recurrence_time_zone" is null)
        or
        ("campaigns"."recurrence" is not null and "campaigns"."recurrence_start_at" is not null and "campaigns"."recurrence_time_zone" is not null)
      )

character_sheets_retired_actor_check.name: character_sheets_retired_actor_check
character_sheets_retired_actor_check.value: "character_sheets"."retired_at" is not null or "character_sheets"."retired_by" is null

sheet_conditions_removed_actor_check.name: sheet_conditions_removed_actor_check

sheet_currencies_removed_actor_check.name: sheet_currencies_removed_actor_check
sheet_currencies_removed_actor_check.value: "sheet_currencies"."removed_at" is not null or "sheet_currencies"."removed_by" is null

sheet_items_removed_actor_check.name: sheet_items_removed_actor_check
sheet_items_removed_actor_check.value: "sheet_items"."removed_at" is not null or "sheet_items"."removed_by" is null

encounter_combatants_source_check.name: encounter_combatants_source_check
encounter_combatants_source_check.value:
(
        ("encounter_combatants"."source" = 'sheet' and "encounter_combatants"."sheet_id" is not null)
        or ("encounter_combatants"."source" = 'custom' and "encounter_combatants"."sheet_id" is null)
      )

encounter_effects_removed_actor_check.name: encounter_effects_removed_actor_check
encounter_effects_removed_actor_check.value: "encounter_effects"."removed_at" is not null or "encounter_effects"."removed_by" is null
